servers.name: doordash-search
servers.originalDescription: Search restaurants and menu items using Meilisearch
servers.aiSummary: Restaurant and menu item search service for DoorDash. Supports full-text search across restaurant names, cuisines, and descriptions with geo-filtering. Can search menu items by name, ingredients, and dietary tags. Provides faceted filtering by cuisine type and detailed restaurant profiles.
aiUseCases: Find restaurants by cuisine or name
Search menu items across restaurants
Filter restaurants by cuisine type
Get restaurant details, hours, and menus
Find food near a specific location
Search for dietary-specific options (vegetarian, gluten-free)

toolDescriptions.name: search_restaurants
toolDescriptions.description: Search restaurants by name, cuisine, or description with optional geo-filtering

toolDescriptions.name: search_menu_items
toolDescriptions.description: Search menu items across all restaurants by name, ingredients, or dietary tags

toolDescriptions.name: filter_by_cuisine
toolDescriptions.description: Get restaurants filtered by cuisine type

toolDescriptions.name: get_restaurant_details
toolDescriptions.description: Get full restaurant profile including hours, address, rating, and menu

servers.name: doordash-orders
servers.originalDescription: Order and commerce management using Medusa
servers.aiSummary: Order and commerce service for DoorDash food delivery. Handles the full order lifecycle from cart creation to checkout and fulfillment. Supports creating orders, checking order status, cancellations with refund processing, promotional code application, and cart management.
aiUseCases: Create a new food delivery order
Check the status of an existing order
Cancel an order and process refund
Apply promotional codes or coupons
Manage shopping cart (add/remove items)
Place an order from a specific restaurant

toolDescriptions.name: create_order
toolDescriptions.description: Create a new delivery order with restaurant, items, and delivery address

toolDescriptions.name: get_order_status
toolDescriptions.description: Check current status and details of an order

toolDescriptions.name: cancel_order
toolDescriptions.description: Cancel an active order and check refund eligibility

toolDescriptions.name: apply_promotion
toolDescriptions.description: Apply a promo code or coupon to an order/cart

toolDescriptions.name: manage_cart
toolDescriptions.description: Add, remove, or update items in a cart before checkout

servers.name: doordash-routing
servers.originalDescription: Delivery routing and ETA calculation using OSRM
servers.aiSummary: Delivery routing and ETA service for DoorDash using real road-network data. Computes optimal delivery routes, estimated arrival times, multi-stop optimization for batched deliveries, and distance matrices for dasher-to-restaurant assignment. Uses actual road networks with turn-by-turn directions.
aiUseCases: Calculate delivery route from restaurant to customer
Get estimated arrival time for a delivery
Optimize multi-stop delivery route for batched orders
Calculate distance matrix for dasher assignment
Get turn-by-turn delivery directions
Track how far away the dasher is

toolDescriptions.name: calculate_delivery_route
toolDescriptions.description: Compute optimal route from restaurant to customer with directions

toolDescriptions.name: get_eta
toolDescriptions.description: Quick ETA lookup given dasher location and destination

toolDescriptions.name: optimize_multi_stop
toolDescriptions.description: Optimize visit order for multiple pickups and dropoffs

toolDescriptions.name: distance_matrix
toolDescriptions.description: Calculate N×M matrix of travel times between points

servers.name: doordash-support
servers.aiSummary: Customer support service for DoorDash. Manages support conversations for order issues, refund requests, dasher complaints, and restaurant feedback. Supports creating tickets, retrieving conversation history, sending messages, assigning agents/teams, and searching help articles for self-service resolution.
aiUseCases: Create a support ticket for an order issue
Get conversation history for a support ticket
Send a message in a support conversation
Escalate a ticket to a specialist team
Search help articles for self-service answers
Report a problem with food quality or delivery

toolDescriptions.name: create_support_ticket
toolDescriptions.description: Open a new support conversation for a customer issue

toolDescriptions.name: get_conversation
toolDescriptions.description: Retrieve full conversation history for a support ticket

toolDescriptions.name: send_message
toolDescriptions.description: Send a reply in an existing support conversation

toolDescriptions.name: assign_agent
toolDescriptions.description: Route or escalate a ticket to a specific agent or team

toolDescriptions.name: search_help_articles
toolDescriptions.description: Search the knowledge base for self-service answers

servers.name: doordash-notifications
servers.aiSummary: Notification service for DoorDash supporting push, SMS, email, and in-app channels. Sends order status updates, delivery tracking alerts, and promotional messages. Supports subscriber preference management for per-channel opt-in/out and notification delivery tracking.
aiUseCases: Send order confirmation notification
Send delivery status update to customer
Send promotional notification with discount code
Check if a notification was delivered
Manage customer notification preferences
Send multi-channel notification (push + email + SMS)

toolDescriptions.name: send_order_notification
toolDescriptions.description: Send notification for order events like confirmed, picked up, delivered

toolDescriptions.name: send_delivery_update
toolDescriptions.description: Send real-time delivery status push notification

toolDescriptions.name: send_promotional
toolDescriptions.description: Send targeted promotional notification to customers

toolDescriptions.name: get_notification_status
toolDescriptions.description: Check delivery status of a sent notification

toolDescriptions.name: manage_subscriber_preferences
toolDescriptions.description: Get or update customer notification preferences per channel
